symptom: Upper Structure Swings Only to the Right or Left
detail_of_failure: The upper structure only swings to one side.
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • The swing LEFT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09001) • The swing RIGHT PPC pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 09002)

steps.procedure: 1. Take measurements. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Examine PPC Valve Outlet Pressure”. 2. Does the measurement result agree with the standard value? branches.YES: Go to the check item of “Swing control valve”.
branches.NO: Go to the check item of “Left shuttle valve of swing motor”.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the swing spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck and that they do not have any damage or dirt on them. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The swing control valve body and spool are correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing control valve body and spool are defective. • Replace the body and spool of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Left shuttle valve of swing motor
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the right and left shuttle valves of the swing motor. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • The left shuttle valve of the swing motor is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The left shuttle valve of the swing motor is defective. • Replace the left shuttle valve of the swing motor. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
